offering_description.value: Builds and sells single-family homes in suburban communities in the Southeast US. It buys and develops land, then builds and sells homes to individual buyers through its own sales centers.

customer_segment.value: B2C: first-time and move-up homebuyers purchasing new homes

revenue_model.value: product sales: sale of newly built homes and lots to individual buyers

value_chain_position.value: other: develops land and builds homes using subcontractors and materials it buys, then sells finished homes to consumers

geography_served.value: US regional: Southeast US, including Georgia, the Carolinas, Tennessee and nearby states

specialization.value: niche specialist: single-family and attached home building only

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated model homes and sales centers in its communities; direct sales: in-house sales staff selling homes directly to buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, land development permits, environmental and fair housing rules, and consumer protection rules for home sales

notes: Exact list of markets and the mix of home types are from memory and may be incomplete or out of date.
